cues.text: Watch F1 Finance's Audit Machine test what customers owe HANGS Construction Services at the year end.
Receivables are money customers still owe.
It picks ten customers to confirm, by size and by risk.
It sends confirmations, letters customers answer straight to the auditors.
Eight reply, and three differ from the books.
Two customers stay silent. One has since paid; one has not.
Then it explains each difference and recomputes the retainage, the share owners hold back until a job is done.
Now it adds up what it found and sets it against materiality.
Then it writes the workpapers and a draft findings memo for the CPA.

All done. The one known error is the $28,600 credit, well under materiality. Add two judgment calls, about $41,000 held back by a customer and up to about $187,000 that may never be paid, and the total passes the auditors' working limit. Seven items stay open. The CPA, a person, concludes and signs. The machine gives no opinion.
